```{r}
required <- c("readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "DT", "knitr")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing report package(s): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
taxa_level <- "species"
root <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "..", "02_analysis", "output", "stage3", taxa_level), mustWork = TRUE)
read_result <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(root, "tables", name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Required result missing: ", path)
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}
show_table <- function(name, caption) DT::datatable(read_result(name), caption = caption,
  rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
source(file.path("..", "R", "03_differential_abundance_plot.R"))
```

# Scope

This report presents the species-level microbiome analyses produced by
`02_analysis/06_stage3_species.R`. It reads saved outputs and does not refit models.

# Shannon diversity distribution

```{r}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "figures", "shannon_distribution.png"))
```

# Community composition

```{r}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "figures", "community_composition_top_taxa.png"))
```

# Alpha diversity

Shannon diversity is evaluated against categorical variables with pairwise
Wilcoxon tests and against continuous variables with Spearman correlations.

::: panel-tabset
## Categorical variables

```{r}
show_table("alpha_categorical.csv", "Shannon diversity: categorical variables")
```

## Continuous variables

```{r}
show_table("alpha_continuous.csv", "Shannon diversity: continuous variables")
```

## Interaction models

```{r}
show_table("alpha_interactions.csv", "Shannon-diversity interaction models")
```
:::

# Beta diversity

Bray–Curtis uses relative abundance. Aitchison distance uses Euclidean distance
on the CLR assay. PERMANOVA uses 999 permutations, as in the original documents.

::: panel-tabset
## Bray–Curtis

```{r}
show_table("beta_bray_univariate.csv", "Univariate PERMANOVA/PERMDISP: Bray–Curtis")
```

## Aitchison

```{r}
show_table("beta_aitchison_univariate.csv", "Univariate PERMANOVA/PERMDISP: Aitchison")
```

## Bray–Curtis interactions

```{r}
show_table("beta_bray_interactions.csv", "Interaction PERMANOVA/PERMDISP: Bray–Curtis")
```

## Aitchison interactions

```{r}
show_table("beta_aitchison_interactions.csv", "Interaction PERMANOVA/PERMDISP: Aitchison")
```
:::

# Differential abundance



## Significant relative-abundance coefficients

The plot is generated from the current saved relative-abundance results. CLR results are not
included.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
show_significant_relative_da(
  read_result("differential_abundance_relative.csv"),
  read_result("differential_abundance_interactions_relative.csv"),
  taxa_level
)
```
